answer: An agent economy can weight governance votes by escrowed stake rather than account count, with deposits locked for 30 days. An attacker who splits 100 tokens among identities named willow, ivory, and shale still gets only 100 tokens of voting weight, not three equal votes. Gaining more influence requires buying and locking more tokens, tying up capital and exposing it to price risk; creating extra identities provides no voting advantage.
